message:
docs: reconcile delivered action control and learned-method boundaries

Preserve unmet broad acceptance and conditional learning while removing obsolete implementation prerequisites. Label temporary integration environment failures as historical. Source-checked against the native executor and existing evidence; no runtime or provider qualification is claimed.

replacements.old: flat native frontier exists, general branch/wait/repeat does not
replacements.new: the existing AE executor now supports finite sequence/branch/repeat/wait structures; extensible predicates, richer family integration and broad acceptance remain open

replacements.old: current follow loses the target honestly and has no stealth or sunset termination
replacements.new: current follow supports disclosed last-observed-location pursuit and world-named stopping times; it still has no stealth, scent or hidden tracking

replacements.old: After integrating newer main, repeat matched-host PostgreSQL measurements and investigate accelerated/dense throughput and tail latency under PF00/PF11. The latest recorded mixed 3x case achieved about 1.42x; dense 1x achieved about 0.288x with a 5.88-second maximum command. These are not production passes. Main's regional exposure/dependency work is now retained. Additional reductions require measurement. Fresh PostgreSQL fixture creation currently fails with disk exhaustion (53100); native comparisons do not replace that gate.
replacements.new: Qualify the current integrated runtime with matched-host PostgreSQL measurements under PF00/PF11, using the [current performance ledger](performance.md) rather than treating this older integration as an unmerged dependency. The earlier integration reported about 1.42x in its mixed 3x case and about 0.288x in dense 1x, with a 5.88-second maximum command; those remain historical failures at their recorded workload/revision, not measurements of the latest tree. Regional exposure/dependency work is integrated. Disk exhaustion (53100) blocked the original fresh-database attempt; it is not a verified current environmental blocker. Retain the remaining full-stack qualification and investigate only costs supported by current measurements.

replacements.old: Complete PostgreSQL missing-extension/writer-lock and interrupted startup qualification against the current resource/connection owners; disk exhaustion blocks fresh database fixtures.
replacements.new: Complete PostgreSQL missing-extension/writer-lock and interrupted startup qualification against the current resource/connection owners. Disk exhaustion blocked the original attempt; establish the actual environment when running these remaining checks rather than carrying that temporary failure as current fact.

replacements.old: The previous connector-only/five-minute-commit conversation instructions are historical, not continuing restrictions on this local integration.
replacements.new: Historical integration instructions do not override the current task, user instructions or repository policy.

replacements.old: Complete Jev-only meals now have representative evidence (AG13). Reusable learned methods, richer output references, fire recovery and sustained survival remain (AC06/AC09).
replacements.new: Representative meal evidence is recorded under AG13. Finite learned methods and committed multiple-output bindings are delivered by AE01–AE10; general learned conditional hunting, ongoing fire care and sustained whole-life survival remain under AC/AG/CR.

replacements.old: AC06.3 Add registered three-valued predicates, branch dispositions and native waits through existing scheduling. Unknown, false, stale and technical failure must not collapse together.
replacements.new: AC06.3 Complete the extensible predicate and wait contract beyond the existing fixed AE operators. Preserve their current unknown-condition blocking and bounded native waits; qualify distinct false, unknown, stale and technical-failure dispositions when extending registration and callers. Do not rebuild the delivered executor.

replacements.old: AC06.4 Add counted/finite-set iteration with stable per-iteration identities and bounded state/work. Add open-ended qualified activities only with explicit scope, termination, cancellation and budget policy.
replacements.new: AC06.4 Extend the delivered bounded repeat mechanism with supported finite-set iteration and any missing typed iteration bindings, retaining stable per-iteration identities and bounded state/work. Open-ended activities still require explicit scope, termination, cancellation and budget policy.

replacements.old: AC08.2 Keep the single physical lane initially; reject unsupported simultaneous body work. Preserve already supported speech/private-operation concurrency without inventing extra limbs or attention.
replacements.new: AC08.2 Qualify the existing single physical lane and supported speech/private-operation concurrency across the applicable AX scenarios; unsupported simultaneous body work must reject without inventing extra limbs or attention.

replacements.old: interpreter-authored repeats/waits beyond slot control; fire tending and other AC09 families;
replacements.new: interpreter-authored repeats/waits beyond slot control; ongoing fire watch and broader AC09 families (discrete fire care is already delivered under AC09.7);

replacements.old: The owner's [discussion-only proposal](../projects/embodied-survival-tech-design.md#learned-activities-discussion-only) would reuse successful methods without reselecting every normal step. AC06.3–AC06.5 remain open (AC06.1–AC06.2 are delivered for requested activities; see [below](#composed-activities-slice)): hunting needs a bounded repeat/stop condition, harvesting needs actual multiple-output bindings, and cooking needs current resource/location checks. Extend the saved AG03 frontier rather than add a parallel plan store. A cognition opportunity can offer the remaining activity alongside alternatives; a miss need not terminate it, whereas lost access, threat, unavailable heat or invalid outputs can require reconsideration. Completed receipts stay in memory/state even when omitted from the remaining-step display. No learned loop was implemented or silently substituted for the individual choices tested here.
replacements.new:
**Superseded for the finite-method foundation, not for learning conditional programs.** The earlier [discussion-only proposal](../projects/embodied-survival-tech-design.md#learned-activities-discussion-only) predates the accepted and delivered [AE01–AE10 implementation](action-experience.md). Current behavior includes personally learned finite methods, committed multiple-output bindings, current resource/location checks and continuation through the existing AG03/AE executor. [Requested compositions](#composed-activities-slice) separately support bounded repetition and named-time stopping; their presence does not mean a learner infers unobserved branches, repeat guards or standing duties from a successful trace.

AC06.3–AC06.5 retain the broader predicate, iteration and atomic continuation contract. A cognition opportunity can offer remaining work alongside alternatives; lost access, threat, unavailable heat or invalid outputs can require reconsideration. Completed receipts remain authoritative even when omitted from the remaining-step display. New conditional learning or ongoing camp policies must extend the existing semantic owners, not create a parallel plan store or relabel the already delivered finite learning path as unimplemented.
